title: WOC Simulated Cricket Stats
scope: Global: all saved matches across servers; no server or user identifiers are exported.
coverage_note: Exports cover fields persisted by the simulator. Partnership-by-partnership, ball commentary, toss decisions and exact batter-v-bowler pairs are not stored in the current sim-stat database.
